reason: The cited lines show API calls using an existing connection/access token to retrieve wiki lists, page metadata, and page text, and return that data to the agent, so they support SECRET. Wiki page/content data is externally authored and returned, including via createExternalContentResponse, so UNTRUSTED is supported. There is no arbitrary host code execution shown, so HOSTEXEC is not supported. The lines do show outbound requests, but the destination is built from connection.serverUrl rather than clearly being agent-chosen or attacker-readable; from these lines alone SINK is not settled.
